build_receipt.scope: Before is main plus the identical opt-in benchmark. After changes native pin projection and adds a correctness test. Pinned Chromium and optimized GN arguments are shared.

before.gn_args:
# Experimental production candidate. Adopt only after matching measurements.
# Requires the mac-arm profile pinned by Chromium's chrome/build/mac-arm.pgo.txt.
is_debug = false
is_component_build = false
use_thin_lto = true
thin_lto_enable_optimizations = true
chrome_pgo_phase = 2
dcheck_always_on = false
symbol_level = 0
blink_symbol_level = 0
v8_symbol_level = 0
target_cpu = "arm64"
use_remoteexec = false
use_siso = false

root_extra_deps = ["//third_party/zitter_libarchive:rar_reader_tests",  "//zitter_ui_lab:zitter_ui_lab", "//zitter_optimized:zitter_optimized", "//zitter_optimized:zitter_prototype_optimized" ]

build_receipt.scope: Private output; all product objects rebuilt from isolated sources. Final same-widget transfer, capped insets, focus and bulk reset handling.
